title: The Status tab shows "in batch N" for a step whose only live PR is already in a green batch
why: Retrospective 11:43 CST Nov 13: a step stays "doing" when its only live PR is in a green batch, so the tab reads as if a lane were still working. Triage pick (undoable, drop the step): yes, show "in batch N".
note: Waiting-page and roadmap blocks: when a step's lane is finished and its PR is a lane in an open batch PR, the row says "in batch N (#PR)" with the batch PR's state read at build time. The live file (roadmap/live/live.json) already holds the batch lanes; read them there. Cost: no new reads at build time beyond the live file.
